propositions: The Cloud differ computes body-equality dedup key via `sanitizer.fit_comment` using a plain 32,767-character cap, while the send path fits via `AdfCodec.fit_outbound` measuring serialized ADF against 32,000 bytes with marker budget reserved

For over-length comments (40k+ chars), the compare key (32767 chars) and landed body (31753 chars) diverge structurally, so the body-equality secondary skip is dead code and a lost map write causes re-posting on every pass
The divergence origin is commit 27b868ba55 (789c-1251-fc21-4cf6, emersed-specific-mutt), which moved the send path off the shared fitter while leaving the differ on it
The fix restores convergence by making Cloud's `_JiraSanitizer.fit_comment` return the same marker-free text the send path lands, via `fit_comment_as_sent(text, AdfCodec.fit_outbound)`
Two existing tests pinned the pre-27b868ba55 send-path model and went stale; both are retargeted to derive expectations from the real send path and confirmed RED on revert mutations
